text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As summer training camp was drawing to a close—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that right?
However... it is still incomplete.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"To complete this song,
I need to run in many more races."

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text: For instance... what about the Kikuka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: You're coming, aren't you? To the Kikuka-sho.

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Because I made a promise to you...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Bravissimo...!!
This just made things even more fun...!!

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
"Let's both train to our absolute limits.
And then, let's blow everyone away."

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text: Just how incredible our race is—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Once we're back at the academy, I'd like to post
something about the Kikuka Sho. Could you prep it for me?
choice_data_list: Leave it to me! I've actually already got everything prepared!
Leave it to me! Actually, I've already prepared it!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fantastico!!
As expected of you, Trainer...!

text_block_list.text:
Summer ends, and autumn arrives.
The autumn where the final stop of the Triple Crown awaits—
